explanation: Simulate the first k swaps of Fisher–Yates on 0 through n−1 without allocating the full range. A hash map records only positions whose values changed; collect the first k virtual positions.
timeComplexity: O(k) expected sampling time; the wrapper performs repeated statistical trials.
